title: Yummy Vietnamese Rice Noodles
description: Light, pillowy Vietnamese rice noodles tossed in a funky Chinese sesame sauce and served in a fondue pot for a shojin-friendly, quick meal.
instructions: Bring a pot of water to a rolling boil and add a pinch of salt.
Add the rice noodles and cook for 3 to 4 minutes until al dente, then drain and rinse with cold water.
In a bowl, whisk together soy sauce, sesame oil, rice vinegar, minced garlic, and chili flakes until smooth.
Toss the noodles in the sauce, shaking until the noodles are evenly coated.
In a separate pan, lightly stir-fry the tofu cubes until golden brown and add them to the noodles.
Sprinkle chopped coriander over the dish and serve with lime wedges on the side.
Serve hot directly from the fondue pot, allowing diners to dip and stir as desired.
